attempts.text: {"claims":[{"claim_text":"The nation's naturalization process should be fair and accessible to legal permanent residents eager to become citizens.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The immigration bureaucracy is dysfunctional and hampers family reunification.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The number of immigration visas for family members and for immigrants meeting job demand will be increased, as long as appropriate labor market protections and standards are in place.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Discrimination against Americans who follow immigration rules should be fought.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Undocumented immigrants in good standing should be required to pay a fine, pay taxes, and learn English.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Undocumented immigrants who meet requirements should go to the back of the line for the opportunity to become citizens.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Undocumented immigrants who follow rules can become full tax-paying, law-abiding, productive members of society.", "claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
